---
description: Implement a task of a newcoder spec
---

Implement one task of a newcoder spec.

1. Read `.newcoder/specs/<spec>/requirements.md`, `design.md` and `tasks.md`.
2. Implement only the requested task, following the design and the project conventions in AGENTS.md.
3. Add or update the tests that prove its acceptance criteria.
4. Tick the task's box in tasks.md and commit with the trailer `Spec-Task: <spec>/T<n>`, naming the spec, in this commit and in any earlier commit of the same task.
5. If the task contradicts the spec, stop and propose a spec change instead of implementing it silently.
